svg.aria-label: The core and its five Slots
svg.title: The core and its five Slots
svg.desc: The core has three parts. orchestrator.md runs one Cycle: it watches Workers, spawns and respawns them, moves Tasks and sends messages, and never does Task work. worker-rules.md tells every Worker to run its Closed Loop, then commit, test, review, open the PR and move the Task to In Review. state.json is the only memory between Cycles. Five Slots plug in, each through one notes file and one Contract: Host (examples Claude Code, Codex, KiroCrew, OpenClaw), Runtime (Herdr, tmux), Tracker (GitHub Issues, a Markdown folder), Review System (GitHub PR, a local branch) and Notifier (a log file, KiroCrew or OpenClaw messaging, an MCP server).
